verdict.rationale: The project's own RELEASE-NOTES.md documents a steady stream of releases: new harness support (Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok Build CLI, an Antigravity Marketplace manifest), bug fixes such as worktree removal no longer destroying untracked files and plan-scoped workspaces, and workflow restructures. A community commenter independently confirms 'a recent update' changed the self-review behavior, which corroborates ongoing releases. Missing for 10: any evidence of issue triage, any evidence of accepted community contributions or PRs, and dated release history showing recency.
